name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on kitchen size, cabinet layout, and whether the job is a careful deconstruction or a faster demolition. Many standard kitchens can be removed in a single day, but more complex layouts, tight access, or added appliance and countertop work can extend the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple cabinet removals can often be done in a day. Larger kitchens, tight access, or jobs that include countertops, appliances, or utilities usually take longer.
